personal.name: Felipe Silva
personal.competencies:
Senior Software Engineer with 18+ years of experience delivering high-complexity systems and distributed processing for global industry leaders — including an 8-year tenure at Capgemini and 6+ years as a consultant at Avenue Code, currently driving engineering excellence for eBay.

Proven expertise in mission-critical, high-availability systems, transforming massive data volumes into resilient business solutions. Solid background in architectural best practices, CI/CD pipelines, and AI-driven development.

Fluent in English, actively improving French (B2 Certificate). 

Currently based in Montreal.

sideProjects.name: Band on the Run
sideProjects.description: Music has always been my primary creative outlet and a vital part of my life outside of engineering.

experiences.role: Senior Software Engineer — Lead Consultant for eBay
experiences.description: Leading architectural decisions and high-impact solutions for eBay's SEO/AEO ecosystems. Engineered mission-critical canonical URL infrastructure and distributed systems processing massive data volumes for global search visibility. Pioneered AI-driven workflows and LLM integration (Spring AI) to boost engineering productivity. Additionally, optimized talent acquisition by developing a high-efficiency technical interview process for the eBay pipeline.

experiences.role: Senior Software Engineer — Consultant for eBay
experiences.description: Acted as a technical consultant leading the development of solutions for purchase planning and product distribution. Architected the transition from legacy Java/Spring systems to a modern microservices architecture using Spring Boot, focusing on process agility and system scalability.
Designed and developed desktop solutions and REST APIs with automated update agents. Implemented cloud-based monitoring and engineered IoT integrations for RFID and SmartCard (HID) systems.

Led the development of mission-critical applications for the Brazilian Ministry of Health, including mortality control and indigenous health monitoring systems. Acted as a key technical lead in designing reusable components across multiple federal projects and architected solutions for government legislation management and digital publishing.

Delivered high-impact solutions within a fast-paced Software Factory environment for major Telecom players (Oi, Brasil Telecom, Telemig Celular). Engineered anti-fraud control systems and high-traffic web portals. Specialized in cross-platform integrations between Java ecosystems and enterprise workflow tools (Remedy), while managing diverse management applications across multiple tech stacks.
